inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A battle stage in the land of the Bloodridge, a sun cult of faceless hooded guardians, the same people as their settlement in the camp: low tents of rotted sepia and ash brown rags, tall black stone obelisks with thin glowing ember cracks, ragged banners with a dark red sun disc on poles, bronze braziers, ram skulls and burial bandages hung on poles, temples in the manner of ancient Egypt. Ash brown, sepia and corroded bronze with ember light, in bright clear full colour. Ember light glows only in the cracks of the obelisks and in braziers, never on the ground. Only the few things named for this place stand here, along the far edge; nothing else is built anywhere in the picture. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. No people anywhere, the fighters are added later. This place: the war camp, their army's tents on the valley floor in the morning.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "a bright readable battle stage in a real lived in place of a sun cult, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth and scale, readable silhouettes, the open ground calm and even so fighters read on it", "lighting": "Clear morning sun from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#2a6ab8", "#8cc0ea", "#e6f2fa", "#a8423a", "#6e2a2a", "#c8c2bc", "#a49e9a", "#e2d6ba", "#3e302c", "#7a6250", "#96703e", "#f07828"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade fighting game stage, no people. The top third is sky and distant land, and the landmarks stand along the far edge of the open ground with their feet on one line a third of the way down. Everything below that line is one wide open flat ground where two armies will fight, calm and empty from the left edge to the right edge, with nothing standing on it.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 221, 1000], "desc": "a clear bright morning sky, deep blue above fading to pale blue at the horizon, a few small white clouds"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [156, 0, 325, 1000], "desc": "the long cliffs of the blood red ridge far away across a wide valley, a dark stepped pyramid and a temple gate of two pylon towers small on its top, thin columns of smoke rising"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [279, 0, 377, 1000], "desc": "rows of low tents of rotted sepia and ash brown rags along the far edge, lines of burial bandages strung between poles"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [143, 109, 377, 232], "desc": "a tall pole hung with ram skulls and a ragged banner with a dark red sun disc, a bronze brazier with ember light at its foot"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [156, 428, 377, 494], "desc": "a tall black stone obelisk with thin glowing ember cracks"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [130, 654, 377, 908], "desc": "an ancient siege catapult of corroded bronze with a tall throwing arm and a sling, a heap of rough boulders beside it"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [373, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "flat pale ash grey packed earth of the camp ground, trampled smooth, crisp and clear, calm and even, no dust and no fog"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [846, 0, 1000, 123], "desc": "a dark broken rock in the near foreground, in shadow"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [846, 886, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a toppled bronze brazier and a heap of sepia rags in the near foreground, in shadow"}]}}
